system.description:
Range 60ft to the container; 120ft to the host.

  • Your body falls Unconscious while your soul enters a gem or crystal.
  • You can possess one creature that fails a Will save, using its physical abilities but not its spells or class features; Will negates (a creature that saves is immune for 24 hours).
  • You return when you choose or the host dies.
  • If the container is destroyed with your soul in it, you die.
  • Material: a gem or crystal worth 100 gp, which is the vessel (not consumed).

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Warlock, Necromancer, Witch
